content: in june 2023 a civil case was brought before the klaipeda district court regarding the termination of a matrimonial community property the parties involved are not mentioned the court has made a final decision on the division of property in a divorce case the applicant has been awarded half of the immovable property a car and ordered to pay compensation for the higher value of the property the court has dismissed some of the defendants claims the court has also ordered the payment of various fees and stamp duties by both parties the court will consider evidence and make decisions on other issues raised by the parties the marriage was dissolved due to the defendants infidelity according to the applicant the court has approved the dissolution of the marriage and upheld the defendants counterclaim the husband will keep his surname while the wife will keep her married name the court has awarded the wife half of the immovable property a car and ordered her to pay compensation the court has dismissed the rest of the husbands claims and ordered the payment of costs and stamp duties

metadata.marital_regime: issues relatively division of common properties
